packageRules.description: OpenTelemetry api + sdk + OTLP/Prometheus exporters release in lockstep (the prometheus exporter's 0.x line pairs with the 1.x api/sdk line); bumping one alone breaks the build.
AWS SDK packages (boto3, botocore, aiobotocore) share a release train and must move together; boto3/botocore also carry bleeding-edge overrides in pyproject [tool.uv].
Azure Key Vault client + identity move together.
pytest and its plugins (cov, asyncio, httpx) version together to avoid plugin/core API mismatches.
